name: SK Hynix
day_summary: HISTORIC SESSION — ₩3,000,000 ATH THEN CIRCUIT BREAKERS. June 23 KST KOSPI session (00:00–06:30 UTC June 23) produced the most dramatic intraday reversal in SK Hynix history. The session opened at approximately ₩2,728,000 (below June 22 ATH close ₩2,919,000 — early profit-taking), then surged to a new intraday ATH of approximately ₩3,000,000, BRIEFLY dethroning Samsung Electronics as Korea's most valuable company by market cap for the first time in 25 years (Seoul Economic Daily June 23 confirmed: '25-Year Reign Ends: SK hynix Becomes Korea's Top Stock by Market Cap'). The historic ₩3,000,000 milestone was followed by a violent reversal: volatility interruption (VI) circuit breakers triggered TWICE as SK Hynix and Samsung both fell ~-12% on profit-taking and reports of Samsung's HBM4E competitive advancement (TradingKey June 23: 'Korean Stocks Trigger Circuit Breakers Twice in a Single Day; SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics Both Plunge 12%'). KOSPI closed -4.6% (Bloomberg). Estimated SK Hynix June 23 KST close: approximately ₩2,569,000 (-11.6% to -12.0% from ₩2,919,000). NOTE: estimated close has moderate confidence (Bloomberg/TradingKey confirm ~-12%; Investing.com cited -7.5%; range ₩2,569,000–₩2,700,000; exact close to be confirmed at KOSPI data release). Stop level ₩2,540,000 is INTACT even at estimated close ~₩2,569,000 (margin: ~₩29,000). Two-consecutive-close rule for stop: today would be Day 1 of a potential stop sequence only if close is at or below ₩2,540,000, which is NOT the case at ~₩2,569,000. Fundamental thesis unchanged: June 24 US session (Micron Q3 + NVDA Annual Meeting) is the primary HBM demand read-through event; June 25 KST is the MOST IMPORTANT KOSPI session of the week.
